import time
import numpy as np
from tasks.t0052_minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba.code.run_tuning_curve import setup_sweep_artifacts
from tasks.t0052_minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba.code.constants import TrialMode, AP_THRESHOLD_MV
from tasks.t0052_minimal_dsgc_scalar_gaba.code.trial import run_one_trial
artifacts = setup_sweep_artifacts()
from neuron import h
# Try using cvode (variable time-step) to speed up
h.cvode.active(True)
h.cvode.atol(1e-3)
print('cvode active=', h.cvode.active())
t0 = time.time()
res = run_one_trial(h=h, cell=artifacts.cell, pairs=artifacts.pairs, mode=TrialMode.AMPA_ONLY, angle_deg=0.0, trial_seed=1)
elapsed = time.time() - t0
print(f'AMPA_ONLY trial time={elapsed:.2f}s n_spikes={len(res.spike_times_ms)} v_soma min={res.v_soma_mv.min():.2f} max={res.v_soma_mv.max():.2f}')
v = res.v_soma_mv
# Check time of v_max
i_max = int(np.argmax(v))
print(f'v_max at sample {i_max} t={res.t_ms[i_max]:.2f} ms')
# Print a window of 50 samples around v_max
lo = max(0, i_max-25)
hi = min(len(v), i_max+25)
print('v[i_max-25..i_max+25]:', list(map(lambda x: f'{x:.2f}', v[lo:hi])))
